While it makes sense that Pontos' 2 cost command card *gauntwards call* can only generate gaunts at first use, but why is its shield generation also tied to that? 

Is this intentional or a bug? If intentional, could you explain what the design philosophy behind it is? If it's a bug, could you please fix it so that subsequent uses of this command card can also generate shields?

All that card does is putting 3 gaunts in hand, be it generated or drawn, so I do not see any discernible differences between first use and subsequent ones pre E3; and even with E3, the discount of gaunts are completely separate from this card itself, which makes this change of behaviour very contrived.

content:
Heyya, making this post since some fuss was made in chat about the conversion of protoparadises when used on units at AA/+12
The ingame gacha rules specificies that when obtaining a dupe for a character when they're fully enlightened will provide a soul shard and 150 radix. It also has a note, mentioning that on self selection methods (i.e. Protoparadise) will provide no conversion.
As of the time of posting this, using protoparadise will reward you with a soul shard but no radix. This has come to be a strategy to AA standards to get a universal selector.
However, it was brought up that this could change this patch (where we'll also be obtaining 5 Origin of Times for resetting standards), with an urgency tone to it.
I believe that this change will not occur, but we would like to have a definitive answer for this.
